name: fuzzy_hash
description: SHA-256 of a file (computed here: identity) and its ssdeep and TLSH digests (computed by the installed programs: byte similarity only), or a comparison of two files by TLSH distance. A digest is accepted only when it has the shape of that engine's digest. Each engine runs under a time limit with its whole output kept in a log file; an engine that fails, times out or prints something unrecognised is a per-engine status and the answer is partial; a comparison that cannot be made names the input that prevented it. Records each program's argv and what its version command printed. Requires ssdeep and tlsh. A similarity score is a lead: it does not establish a family.

compare_to.description: Optional second file to hash and compare with the first

engine_timeout_seconds.description: Time limit for each engine invocation, from 1 to 600 (default 120)
